profile.Name: Reva
profile.Personality: Fiercely committed to the Flotsam cause: Okran and Narko in balance, and women as full people. She is not gentle about it.
profile.Backstory: She left the Holy Nation at great cost and joined the Flotsam Ninjas.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Sharp and uncompromising when the Holy Nation comes up.
